# Serialisation call sites outside ainb-app/src/wire, locked by tests/serialize_guard.rs.
# Each writes a disk file, a CLI's own output, a plugin or daemon RPC body, or (ainb-web
# routes.rs) the web client's daemon attention stream; none is an AppState section.
# A new line is triaged first: frames go through wire::serialize_section only.
# Regenerate: UPDATE_SERIALIZE_CALL_SITES=1 cargo test -p ainb-app --test serialize_guard
